definition.description: Render a definition-style answer when the user asks what something is

how_to.description: Render step-oriented instructions for how-to questions
templates: To {predicate} {task_topic}, start with the essential steps and build carefully from there.
Here is how to {predicate} {task_topic}: break it into small steps and work through each one.

creative_riddle.description: Render a riddle when output_type is riddle or creative_form
templates: Here is a riddle: I am always new yet never young. What am I? A {topic_if_entity}.
Riddle me this: What is full of meaning but never speaks? A {topic_if_entity}.

entity_property_advice.description: Render advice about handling an entity with known fragile properties
templates: {task_topic} is fragile. Handle it carefully with two hands and avoid impact or sudden movement.

entity_property_explanation.description: Explain why an entity has a certain property (reasoning-protected)
templates: {task_topic} is fragile because its materials can crack or break under impact or pressure.

technical_how_to.description: Render technical instruction with normalization alerts
templates: To {predicate} {task_topic}, use the appropriate syntax. Note that some technical terms may be normalized by the parser.
Here is how to {predicate} {task_topic}: look up the correct property or method. Some domain tokens may appear simplified.

learned_unknown_skill.description: Render a response when skill is not installed but learned facts exist
templates: I do not have a dedicated {task_topic} skill installed yet. I can use my general knowledge to help.
I do not have a specific skill for {task_topic}, but I know some things about it.
